# Requirements

## Requirement 1: Agent parity

### Acceptance Criteria

1. No ready interactive sidecar precedes hydration or registered declared controls; navigation does not retain old-page controls.
2. Copy, theme and docs search are addressable, described and operable with machine-readable outcomes.
3. Home markdown and HTML identify the same declared controls without advertising server execution for browser-only operations.
4. Focused unit tests and a real built-site browser journey cover initial readiness, actions, navigation, mobile and the markdown endpoint.
